snippet.title: QBIX Game | Pack-a-Boom Trailer
snippet.description:
Pack-a-Boom: Navigate, Collect, Conquer. The Ultimate Maze Action Game!

It’s a complete challenge for guests to navigate through a maze, collect points, discover treasures, dodge traps, outsmart enemies, and outrun friends. Up to 6 players can compete to see who can collect the most points and emerge as the ultimate winner!

www.inowize.com
